title: Eomesodermin in renal cell carcinoma: Epigenetic and immune crosstalk driving tumor progression (Review).
snippet: Renal cell carcinoma (RCC) is the main pathological type of kidney cancer, which accounts for approximately 85‑95% of all cases of kidney cancer. Despite the emergence of targeted therapies and immunotherapies, however, the development of resistance remains common.
